messages:
lina: Dropping a compact-density proposal for Roles + invite UX. Goal: reduce vertical noise for large orgs, surface SSO enforcement, and make audit-jump faster. mock: https://img.redwood.test/ux/roles-compact-v3.png lina: Key changes: 1) compact row density (tight gutters, 10px vertical). 2) persistent per-user visibility toggle (All / SSO-only / Pending). 3) header-level SSO chip: 'Org SSO: Enforced' with an inline 'why?' link. jonah: Nice. For the per-user toggle, pls make the state independent from team filters (we had confusion last Q where filter and team view clashed). Persist in localStorage first. lina: yep localStorage for now. server-backed later if customers ask. rachel: Copy nit on the header chip: instead of 'Enforced' can we use 'Required' — clearer for non-technical admins. Also add tooltip: 'Members must sign in via SSO to access org resources.' mina: Accessibility: tooltips must be keyboard-focusable and we need aria-describedby linking to the chip for screen readers. Also color contrast 90%: the chip bg needs 4.5:1 against white for 14px text. ops-bot: contrast check failed for current amber. ops-bot: Color contrast result: #f2a84b on #ffffff = 3.2:1 (FAIL). Suggested alternatives: #d97a20 or #b86b1a for AA small text. jonah: Good catch. Also on the invite drawer: propose the small inline status line under the email field instead of a blocking banner. Example: 'SSO required for this org' in muted text then a link 'learn more'. lina: updated mock: https://img.redwood.test/ux/invite-inline-sso.png. Using shield icon + helper text. Kept it visually light so it doesn't feel like an error. mina: For dynamic validation when someone types an email that's not SSO-enabled, use aria-live="polite" and set role="status" on the helper element so screen readers announce it. Sample pattern: ```
Org requires SSO. Invited user will be prompted to join via SSO.
``` rachel: UX question: if SSO is required, should we prevent invites to emails outside the org domain? Some customers want a soft block, others want to allow external contractors. Maybe add a toggle in admin settings: 'Allow external invites when SSO is required'. lina: good product question. I'll add a callout in the settings mock and add an admin-level override. jonah: Audit log nav: proposal to add 'Related actions' in the event detail right rail. Example links: 'Invites (4)', 'Role changes (2)', 'SSO events (6)'. Clicking open a small inline list so you don't lose context. mina: Keyboard shortcut request: open filter picker with `f` and cycle options with arrow keys. Also allow quick-apply: `f` then `enter` to apply focused option. Document in shortcuts modal (Shift+/). lina: i'll wire keyboard interactions in the prototype. Also will add a small HUD hint the first time a user uses the Roles page. ops-bot: Reminder: run regression on small-screen (1024x768) layouts — compact rows must not overlap action icons. mina: QA checklist from accessibility side: 1) chip with aria-describedby, 2) tooltip keyboard focus, 3) aria-live for validation, 4) contrast >= 4.5, 5) row truncation should allow two-line wrap. rachel: Copy for the invite helper we landed on: 'Org requires SSO. Invited users must sign in with your SSO provider. Learn more.' keeps it short and actionable. lina: Thanks all. I'm going to iterate mocks with the contrast changes, add the admin override, and prototype keyboard flow. Will post a short demo clip and a PR for review tomorrow. :rocket: jonah: thanks! excited to test. mina: ping me for an a11y pass. lina: (thread closed)
